configure_profiling: configure habitat profiling to start capturing at a specific step and capture a set number of steps
on_start_step: signal the start of a profiling step to habitat_sim profiling utilities
range_push: push a named profiling range marker onto the NVTX profiling stack
range_pop: pop the most recent profiling range marker off the NVTX profiling stack
use_range_context: annotate a code block with a profiling range using the RangeContext context manager or decorator
